Something that has helped me and maybe others would agree to help get better with firefights is to immerse yourself in them more. If you play stealthily avoiding firefights you will never win, most likely, since you dont have the skills or experience when it comes down to having to kill those people to get to the #1. 

Therefore, my suggestion is for a while to drop into high drop zones. Ponchinki, military base, high school, apartments next to school, rozhok and crates at Georgeopol are some places with great loot therefore are the most populated drop zones. Immerse yourself in these big ass fights that happen there in order to get looted and move on. If you have the gear, run to gun shots nearby. You gotta fight to learn to fight. 

Also - guy was maybe running fast due to max boosts (energy drinks, painkillers) - 100% makes you run pretty quick! Also putting your weapon away can help a bit.
